Problem Statement
Read a word and print its length, its first character, its last character, the word in reverse order and the word in capital letters.
Description
Read a word. Print the length of the word, the first character of the word, the last character of the word, the word written in reverse order, and the word written in capital letters.
Input Description
A single word that contains only letters and no spaces. (1 <= length of the word <= 50)
Output Description
Print 5 lines: the length, the first character, the last character, the reversed word and the word in capital letters. The first character, the last character and the reversed word must be printed exactly as given in the input (capital letters stay capital and small letters stay small).

python
Sample Output
